items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: we'd always end up our Uncle Dan's on La Salle Street

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. And I went basically all those clubbing one time or another. But it's been so long ago man, I can't remember. Then whenever we'd go out, we'd always end up our Uncle Dan's on La Salle Street, go and get some food. Yeah. He was known for his grits and liver. stuff
Uncle Dan's, where was that? Was it near the Dewdrop?
